content: Ayhudeta Xoonuwa

Adaare geetetiya tammanne nam7antho ageenan tammanne heedzantho gallasay gakis. He gallas, kawoy koyro kessida awaajuwa maaran morketi Ayhudeta xoonana gida qopida gallasaa. Shin oday shireti wodhin, Ayhudeti banta morketa xoonidosona.

Kawa Arxekisisa kawotethan de7iya Ayhudeti ubbay bantana qohanaw koyiya ubbaa dhaysanaw banta kataman kataman issife shiiqidosona. Hara zare gidida asay entaw yayyida gisho, entara ay asika eqetanaw danda7ibeenna.
Enti Mardikiyoosas yayyida gisho, kawope garsara biitta haareysati, awuraja ayseysatinne biitta halaqati ubbay Ayhudeta maaddidosona.
Mardikiyoosi kawo gadhon gita maati imetidanne wolqan guji guji biya asi gideysi he kawotethan de7iya biitta ubban eretis.
He gallas Ayhudeti banta morketa ubbaa mashshan goyridi wursidosona; bantana ixiya ubbaa bolla koydaba oothidosona.
Waanna katama gidida Suusa xalaalan ichashu xeetu asaa wodhidosona.
Enti Parshandata, Dalfoona, Aspata,
Porata, Adala, Ardata,
Parmashita, Arsaya, Ardayanne Wayzata wodhidosona.
Enti Ayhudeta morke gidida Haama nayta. Shin enti enta shaluwa bonqibookona.
Ayhudeti Suusa kataman wodhida asaa tayboy aapuneko he gallas kawas odetis.

Yaatin, kawoy kawiw Astiro, “Ayhudeti waanna katama gidida Suusa xalaalan ichashu xeetu asaanne tammu Haama nayta wodhidosona. Hessi hessa gidiko, kawa biittatan enti wodhiday aapuna gidandesha! Qassi ha77i neeni woossiyabay aybee? Taani new immana. Neeni tana oychiyabay harabay aybee? Taani new polana” yaagis.
Astira zaarada, “Kawa ha qofay ufaysiko, Suusa kataman de7iya Ayhudeti hachi oothidaysada wontoka ootho. Qassi tammu Haama nayta ahaa mitha bolla kaqanaada kiitta” yaagasu.
Kawoy hessa oothana mela kiittis. Awaajoy Suusa kataman nam7antho awaajetin, tammu Haama nayta ahay kocaa bolla kaqetis.
Adaare geetetiya ageenan tammanne oyddantho gallasan, Suusa kataman de7iya Ayhudeti issife shiiqidi, hara heedzu xeetu asaa wodhidosona; shin ha77ika enta shaluwa bonqibookona.

He wode Suusa katamaape gaxara de7iya kawa biittatan de7iya Ayhudeti issife shiiqidi, banta morketa ubbaa olidosona. Enti laapun tammanne ichashu mukulu asaa wodhidaape guye banta morketape shempidosona. Shin enta shaluwa bonqibookona.
Haysi ubbay haniday Adaare geetetiya ageenan tammanne heedzantho gallasaana. Tammanne oyddantho gallasan enti shempidosona; gibira mishe, uyishenne ufaytishe pee7iya gallas oothidosona.
Purima Ba7aale

Shin Suusa kataman de7iya Ayhudeti tammanne heedzanthonne tammanne oyddantho gallasan wodhishe pee7idi, tammanne ichashantho gallasan shempidosona. Enti he gallasaa mishe, uyishenne ufaytishe pee7iya gallas oothidosona.

Hessa gisho, guutha katamatan de7iya Ayhudeti hachi gakanaw Adaare geetetiya ageenan tammanne oyddantho gallasaa ba7aale gallas oothidi bonchoosona. He gallasan moosonanne uyoosona; qassi issoy issuwas imota immoosona.
Mardikiyoosi ha hanida taarike ubbaa xaafidi, kawa Arxekisisa biitta ubban, haahoninne matan de7iya Ayhude ubbaas yeddis.
He dabdaabiyan Mardikiyoosi Adaare ageenan tammanne oyddanthonne tammanne ichashantho gallasata, Ayhudeti laythan laythan ba7aale gallas oothidi bonchana mela entaw odis.

He gallasati Ayhudeti banta morketape shempo demmida gallasata. Qassi he ageenay enta azzanoynne yeehoy ufaysaninne gibira muussan laametida ageena. Hessa gisho, enti muussaninne ushshan ufaytishe, issoy issuwasinne manqotas katha imota immishe bonchana mela entaw odis.
Ayhudeti Mardikiyoosi immida kiitaa ekidi, enti bonchanaw doomida baaliya, laythan laythan aggonna bonchanaw ma7idosona.
Agaaga kochay, Hamadaata na7ay Haami, Ayhudeta ubbaa morkey, enta dhaysanaw kase maqetidi enta wodhiya ageenanne gallasa eranaw Purima geetetiya saama yegisis.
Shin Astira kawako gelidaape guye, Haami Ayhudeta bolla maqida iita maqoy ubbay guye simmidi, iya bolla poletanaada kawoy xuufen kiittis. Yaatin, Haaminne iya tammu nayti ahay mithan kaqetis
Hessa gisho, ha nam7u gallasati Purima Ba7aale geetetoosona. Ha dabdaabiyan entaw xaafetidaba ubbaa gaason, enti banta ayfen be7idaba gaasoninne enta bolla gakidaba gaason
Ayhudeti bantaw, banta kochatasinne Ayhude gidanaw koyiya ubbaas, ha baaliya woga oothidi bonchidosona. Hessika laythan laythan aggonna ha nam7u gallasata bonchana melasa.

He gallasati yeleta ubban, katamata ubban, Ayhudeta keetha ubbaninne biitta ubban bonchetana mela qashetis. Hessika, Ayhudeti awude gidikoka, ha Purima gallasata bonchanawunne he gallasatan hanidabay enta kochan dogetonna mela qopanaw bessees.
Hessafe guye, Abikaala na7iya, kawiya Astiranne Ayhude addey Mardikiyoosi, Purima Baaliyaba kase xaafida dabdaabiya minthanaw haysa nam7antho dabdaabiya kumetha maatan xaafidosona.
He dabdaabeti Arxekisisa kawotethan, xeetanne laatamanne laapun biittan de7iya Ayhudeta ubbaas saroynne wopatethi gido giya sarotara xaafetidi kiitetidosona.

Qassi enti kase xoomanawunne kayotanaw wogaa kessidaysada, ha77i enta gidin, sinthafe yaana enta kochata gidin, ha Purima gallasata laythan laythan woga oothidi bonchana mela he dabdaabeti qoncisosona. Hessi Ayhude addey Mardikiyoosinne kawiya Astira issife zoretidi kessida kiita.
Kawe Astiri kiitay Purima Ba7aale wogaa minthis; ika maxaafan xaafetis.
